subject: [PATCH v8 22/30] mm/madvise: keep PMD swap entries whole for MADV_GUARD_INSTALL/REMOVE

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the MADV_GUARD_INSTALL and REMOVE callbacks in the Linux kernel to handle PMD swap entries correctly. Currently, these callbacks test for huge pages using pmd_trans_huge(), but this is false for PMD swap entries, leading to incorrect behavior when trying to install or remove guard pages. The patch adds a check for PMD swap entries using pmd_is_swap_entry() and returns immediately if the entry is swapped out, preventing unnecessary splitting of the page table.
